title: Eddington: the stuff of the world is mind-stuff

statements.text: Put crudely, the stuff of the world is mind-stuff. Its nature is not altogether foreign to the feelings of consciousness, it is not spread in space and time, and only here and there does it rise to the level of consciousness. Mind is the first and most direct thing in experience, and all else is remote inference.

sources.quote: but we may think of its nature as not altogether foreign to the feelings in our consciousness
The mind-stuff is not spread in space and time
Only here and there does it rise to the level of consciousness
But no one can deny that mind is the first and most direct thing in our experience, and all else is remote inference
